method: Blinded. Each card showed LINZ aerial imagery at zoom 18, both AMDS centrelines (link A red, link B cyan), the crossing point in yellow, a card code, the two link ids and the two road names. The classifier's disposition and deciding rule were NOT shown; they live in answer-key.json and were joined only after every verdict below was written. Card order was randomised across strata with seed 'at-grade-blinded-review-1'.
reviewer: single reviewer (the model), one pass. NOT independent human ground truth: it is a model-assisted visual review by the same agent that wrote the classifier, blinded to the classifier's answer but not a separate party. Pass 2 in blind-verdicts-recode.json double-codes a subset to measure consistency.
